title: Deduplicate website game cards and viewer bootstraps
description:
The website still has duplicated rendering logic in places that should be sharing a single source of truth.

Concrete duplication today:
- `website/src/scripts/game-list.js` and `website/src/pages/season/[season]/results.astro` both implement hand-built `renderGameCard()` logic for game archive cards.
- Replay, golden, and live viewer pages still bootstrap similar viewer state through separate code paths instead of a unified configurable entrypoint.
- Recent fixes already exposed the cost of this drift: link hardening and clickability had to be repaired in one path without automatically covering the others.

Why this matters:
- Styling and behavior drift over time because each page evolves independently.
- Security fixes have to be applied in multiple places.
- The same UI concepts (game cards, replay header, viewer controls) are tested and maintained separately.

Suggested fix:
1. Introduce a single shared implementation for game cards, preferably an Astro component for server-rendered uses plus a small shared helper for any remaining client-rendered cases.
2. Unify replay/golden/live viewer bootstrap logic behind shared modules with configuration rather than copy-pasted page scripts.
3. Back the shared paths with focused tests so future fixes land once.

This is a consistency issue first, but it should also reduce JS size and bug surface area.
